deltas_from_v18: No carried prediction value changed (P01-P37 verbatim except status notes). P38 added.

Distinction = indistinction (chapter 43.63): at the Z pole the kinetic term (indistinction) equals the mass term (distinction), the propagator's real part vanishes and only the absorptive record remains. With R1, DZ and OE this reduces E5 to a conditional theorem under the reading rule RS (a coupling relation holds at the scale where its coin is recorded). Consequence: the E4 alpha_s must equal the alpha_s recorded at the Z pole (R_l, Gamma_Z, sigma_had); PDG 2024 gives 0.1221 +- 0.0027 (-1.55 sigma; the SM world average itself is 1.4 sigma from it) -> P38.

Fixed-point e-ladder (43.64): the missing FP correction is eps = -(4.94 +- 1.32)e-5 (reduces the bias). The full e-series is rejected (>= +10 sigma). Four forms tie within 0.3 sigma (lam q^2, lam^2/8, lam e^-6, lam^2 e^-2), all seen before the scan: 0 bits. Separating them needs an 8x better tau mass. P34 unchanged.

Higgs weight (43.65): F is the survival partition function of the branching core; reading HB: the Z sees the lineage head, the Higgs sees the head plus one generation of strongly captured offspring. One-step pattern holds a third time (compound and full-recursion forms rejected). The hierarchy row requires M_H = 125.36 +- 0.03 GeV (construction-level agreement with the core F). Exploratory universal factor (1 - q^2) halves the joint chi2 of FP, M_H/M_Z, Omega_m and v/M_Pl but pushes v/M_Pl to +2.61 sigma: not adopted, kept as branch Q2 (M_H = 125.28).
